# Architecture Constitution

The active rules of this repository, rolled up from the decision files that state them.
Edit a decision file and regenerate; never edit this file.

## Rules

### domain-imports-nothing

The domain package must not import infrastructure.

- Severity: blocking
- Scope: `src/domain/**`
- Verified by review — needs judgement, and may be graded as a soft signal.
- Source: [0001 The gateway owns protocol translation](decisions/0001-gateway-isolation.md)

### edge-terminates-protocol

The edge router terminates the protocol and hands domain types inward.

- Severity: blocking
- Scope: `src/edge/**`
- Verified by review — needs judgement, and may be graded as a soft signal.
- Source: [0002 The edge router replaces the gateway](decisions/0002-edge-router.md)

### gateway-owns-translation

Protocol translation happens in the gateway; no handler outside it parses a wire format.

- Severity: blocking
- Scope: `src/legacy/gateway/**`
- Verified by review — needs judgement, and may be graded as a soft signal.
- Source: [0001 The gateway owns protocol translation](decisions/0001-gateway-isolation.md)
